sections.content: Portfolio showing work must be submitted for consideration.

This position at Walrus Audio is responsible for developing all marketing channels to ensure marketing ROI goals are attained. In order to drive the Walrus Audio brand, the applicant is expected to develop and maintain a digital marketing architecture that drives website traffic and ultimately converts traffic to sales. Having a high level understanding of the digital market space along with the ability to create inbound marketing funnels through all available channels is paramount. Direct email marketing, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, and user generated content are only a handful of the current marketing channels. This role requires an eye for detail as it relates to Marketing ROI goals. It also requires a strong understanding of Google Analytics – not just being able to read data, but make quick and effective decisions based on the data it generates.

This candidate is expected to grow online business through all creative content strategies. This will include responsibilities such as coordinating the videography of product technical demos, artist demos, and leading the creative media direction on all marketing efforts including print publication, digital advertisements, email campaigns, product packaging, fliers, other forms of visual marketing, and B2B collateral.

To be effective in this role, it requires someone that is an excellent written and visual communicator, has meticulous attention to details, and can maintain many projects at one time combined with the relentless drive to meet sales goals. This position has the final say on how the Walrus Audio brand is perceived in the market, whether product sales are average or excellent, and more importantly whether our customers are passive consumers or raving fans.
